scope: Every fixed, structural, mātrā, aṃśa, and Telugu deśi meter exposed by the Chandas.org catalogs.
method: Search Internet Archive metadata for public-domain prosody treatises, editions, and named literary works.
Use DJVU OCR and full-text search only to locate candidate pages.
Check the page image or a dependable transcription and cross-check the meter rule before admission.
Admit only attributable, reusable, child-safe text that passes the current analyzer without a violation.
limitations: An OCR name hit is a lead, not meter attribution.
Many catalog names are rare, homonymous, OCR-hostile, or generated from classical combinatorial catalogs.
No example is synthesized to fill a gap; unverified entries remain explicitly pending.

ocrSweep.note: Combined normalized Roman-name hits from downloaded DJVU OCR. These are unverified page-finding leads; Devanagari-only names and OCR damage make this deliberately incomplete.
